page.title: A Pirate's Life
page.t: Heave to. We're taking your ship.
Make the pilot abandon ship without destroying it. Your wing breaks the hull, then only keeps the shields down. Abort this mission to call the capture off.
Keep the pressure on: next bail check
Keep the pressure on: last check %s%%
Force the target's pilot to bail without destroying the ship.

page.title: A Pirate's Life
page.t: No ships of yours are docked here.
Too big: the %s don't take ships this size from you yet.
This station can't take ships this size.
No station you know of takes it as booty.

Dock at a pirate group's wharf or shipyard and hand this ship over as booty: credits, like a sale minus the fence's cut, and booty for that group. Its pilot moves to a free marine slot on your nearest ship with room.
